 Fortnite Treasure Chest Rewards Revealed – Free Skins and Cosmetic Items
 All Fortnite Treasure Chest rewards for Week 1 and 2, including free Solid Gold skins, vehicle cosmetics, and rare Pirate Shop Access tokens.
 By Brent Koepp 
 November 2, 2026, 8:12am 
 Share: 
 Share on X (Opens in new window) X 
 Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook 
 Share using Native tools Share Copied to clipboard 
 Add Us On Google
 Epic Games is giving players a chance to earn free Fortnite Treasure Chest rewards during the Treasure Hunters mini-season. However, dataminers have now revealed the Week 1 and 2 reward pools, including Solid Gold skins, vehicle cosmetics, and Pirate Shop Access.
 Fortnite Treasure Chest Rewards Leaked by Dataminers
 Screenshot: Epic Games 
 Fortnite Treasure Hunters is now live, and players can earn cosmetic items by opening chests . From free gold skins to rare pickaxes, the Fortnite Treasure Chest rewards include some pretty exciting prizes. 
 Videos by VICE 
 There is even a Fortnite Pirate Shop Access Toke n, a rare reward that lets players claim all Item Shop items for free for 14-days straight upon activation. For your convenience, here is the full list of reported Fortnite Treasure Chest rewards for Week 1 and 2, courtesy of dataminer ShiinaBR :
 All Fortnite Treasure Chest Rewards List: Week 1 and 2
 Screenshot: Epic Games 
 Week 1 Rewards – A$AP Rocky
 Reward Item Type 
 Solid Gold A$AP Rocky Outfit 
 Solid Gold A$AP Rocky’s Gauntlets Pickaxe 
 Plunder in Paradise Loading Screen 
 Mercedes-AMG G 63 “G-Wagon” Car 
 Golden Llama Crew G-Wagon Car Decal 
 Gold G-Wagon Wheels 
 No Trespassing – A$AP Rocky Jam Track 
 Screenshot: Epic Games 
 Week 2 Rewards – Lil Uzi Vert
 Reward Item Type 
 Solid Gold Lil Uzi Vert Outfit — currently encrypted 
 Lil’ Uzi Crew Back Bling 
 So Kawaii Loading Screen 
 Cadillac CT5-V Blackwing Car 
 Gold Cadillac Car Decal 
 Cadillac CT5-V Blackwing Wheels 
 London – Lil Uzi Vert Jam Track 
 Screenshot: Epic Games 
 Rewards Available in Both Weeks
 Pirate Shop Access (2026)
 Pirate Shop Access (2027)
 Golden Firework
 Lucky Locator
 Portable Extractor
 Sprite Locator
 Extraction Accelerator
 Screenshot: Epic Games, Snowslept 
 Of course, the biggest prize is easily the Fortnite Pirate Shop Access. The chance to claim eligible Item Shop cosmetics for free makes it a pretty massive reward, although finding it will take some serious luck.
 That said, while you hunt for the golden ticket (er, I mean token), you also have a chance to pick up the Solid Gold skins and other rewards listed above. Just don’t expect every chest to include treasure, as the drop rates are rare.
